overview.headline: Sequencing reads base order and shapes health research

keyPoints.point: Sequencing means determining the order of chemical bases that make up the molecule
keyPoints.quote: Sequencing DNA means determining the order of the four chemical building blocks - called "bases" - that make up the DNA molecule.

keyPoints.point: Adenine always pairs with thymine and cytosine always pairs with guanine to form base pairs
keyPoints.quote: Adenine (A) always pairs with thymine (T); cytosine (C) always pairs with guanine (G).

keyPoints.point: About 3 billion base pairs spell out instructions for making and maintaining a being
keyPoints.quote: The human genome contains about 3 billion base pairs that spell out the instructions for making and maintaining a human being.

keyPoints.point: Goal is to reduce cost of sequencing to even higher quality for less than $1,000
keyPoints.quote: reduce the cost of sequencing a human genome of even higher quality than is possible today and for less than $1,000

keyPoints.point: Nanopore sequencing involves threading single strands through extremely tiny pores in a membrane
keyPoints.quote: Nanopore-based DNA sequencing involves threading single DNA strands through extremely tiny pores in a membrane.

keyTerms.gloss: units called chemical building blocks that make up the molecule
keyTerms.quote: DNA sequencing determines the order of the four chemical building blocks - called "bases" - that make up the DNA molecule.

keyTerms.gloss: directions that contains about 3 billion paired units for making and maintaining a being
keyTerms.quote: The human genome contains about 3 billion base pairs that spell out the instructions for making and maintaining a human being.

keyTerms.gloss: enzyme molecules that are watched as they copy to read sequence in cells
keyTerms.quote: watching DNA polymerase molecules as they copy DNA - the same molecules that make new copies of DNA in our cells

keyTerms.gloss: tiny membrane openings that offer potential advantages for current sequencing methods
keyTerms.quote: Using nanopores to sequence DNA offers many potential advantages over current methods.
